summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting by reading and editing files only; no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last ControlType member and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which passes one two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor; it checks only is_terminal, returns True after buffering the control, and returns False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title text. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200, with the Added section placed above Fixed. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on legacy Windows via detect_legacy_windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Choices to review: the skip mechanism, and the CHANGELOG link format, which follows the repo's existing PR-link pattern.
